Hi Fatima,

Thanks again for agreeing to onboard as a Redwood supplier. To get the PO and the first payment in flight we need a short set of onboarding documents from your side. Can you please provide the following items so we can complete vendor setup in Coupa and issue the PO?

- Completed Redwood vendor onboarding form (attached): vendor name, legal entity, bank details, primary contact.
- Local tax registration: VAT certificate (scanned), and KRA PIN or tax registration number.
- A copy of a recent invoice sample showing VAT line (if available).
- Proof of identity for the signatory (passport/ID) — redacted OK.
- Bank confirmation or voided cheque showing account name, IBAN/SWIFT.

A couple of notes specific to Kenya and cross-border payments:
- If your services are being performed and invoiced from Kenya and you are VAT-registered there, we will pay the invoice gross and Redwood will not withhold VAT. We require the VAT certificate to prove registration.
- If you are not VAT-registered, please confirm so we can advise on whether VAT should be charged or if a reverse-charge / exemption applies.
- Because Redwood is a U.S. entity, for certain US-source income we sometimes request a W-8BEN-E to document foreign status for withholding. For most vendor services provided entirely outside the U.S. this is not needed, but Ive attached our guidance doc to speed things up.

Attached: Redwood-Vendor-Setup-Form.pdf, Sample-Invoice-AFR-001.pdf, W8BEN-E-guidance.pdf

Could you send the VAT cert + completed form by EOD Wednesday 12 Aug so we can aim to issue the PO the following week? If anything on the checklist is a problem, let me know and Ill loop in Finance/Legal.

Best,

Hi all,

Thanks for looping me in. Quick answers and a short checklist we can send to Fatima to close this out:

1) Billing entity: Ask Africargo to invoice Redwood Inference, Inc (U.S. entity) for ease of PO routing. If Africargo prefers to invoice our UK branch, well need a copy of the UK entity name and address to put on the PO. Please include the exact legal name to avoid tax rework.

2) W-8BEN-E: Request a completed W-8BEN-E if Africargo will invoice Redwood Inference, Inc (US) and there is any chance services are performed partly in the U.S. If services are exclusively performed from Kenya and the invoice is for services rendered there, withholding is unlikely — but having W-8BEN-E on file is low friction and helps with tax documentation. So we ask for it "when billing the US entity" as standard practice.

3) VAT treatment: Because Africargo is VAT-registered in Kenya (we have the cert), they should charge VAT on invoices raised from Kenya. Redwood will pay gross. If their services are exported and eligible for zero-rating under Kenyan law, they should indicate that on the invoice and provide supporting declaration.

4) Currency: We prefer USD. If Africargo wants GBP, confirm bank currency and provide a GBP invoice header and we will create a separate PO in GBP.

Checklist to send back to Fatima (one consolidated reply):
- Completed Redwood-Vendor-Setup-Form.pdf (signed)
- VAT certificate (already provided)
- Bank confirmation/voided cheque showing currency and SWIFT
- Completed W-8BEN-E (if invoicing Redwood Inference, Inc) — optional but preferred
- Sample invoice with VAT line (we have, but request updated if bank/currency differs)

Next steps from our side once we receive the completed form and bank proof: set up vendor in Coupa, create PO (USD by default to Redwood Inference, Inc), and send PO + supplier portal invite so they can upload invoice for matching. Expect PO issuance within 3 business days of full doc receipt.

Hannah — feel free to send this verbatim to Fatima. Fatima — thanks for the prompt uploads; if youd like I can provide the exact invoice header text well use on the PO.
